title: Add gateway gate names sprint-close and ship-ready
summary: Introduce named gateway gate terminology and support conditional sprint-close and ship-ready gates while preserving compatibility for existing gateway profile inputs.

goal.outcome: Gateway users and agents can use decision, planning, implementation, task-close, sprint-close, and ship-ready as named gates.
acceptance: Supported gate names include decision, planning, implementation, task-close, sprint-close, and ship-ready.
Gateway docs and public-facing schema/tool language use gate terminology while preserving backward-compatible profile input if retained.
Sprint-close gate validates cohort closure readiness when a sprint is being closed: tasks, shared outcome, cross-task accepted rows, shared risks, and generated state.
Ship-ready gate validates exact-content promotion readiness for commit/package/archive/remote/release targets with immutable proof and approval as needed.
Tests cover accepted gate names, backward compatibility for existing profile calls if retained, sprint-close blockers, and ship-ready proof requirements.
non_goals: Do not implement full worker spawning or automatic validator session launch.
Do not remove backward compatibility abruptly if existing tools/tests use profile.
Do not perform package release or remote push.

delta.desired: Gateway exposes consistent gate terminology with sprint-close and ship-ready gates.
delta.current: Gateway source and schemas use profile/publication terminology; sprint-close and ship-ready are not first-class gate names.
